content.value_statement: Accessibility issues can block users and create compliance risk. This skill guides WCAG audits, manual checks, remediation planning, and repeatable testing.
actual_capabilities: Defines audit scope for WCAG level, target pages, and user journeys.
Guides automated accessibility checks with axe-core, jest-axe, and pa11y examples.
Provides manual checks for keyboard flow, screen readers, contrast, reflow, and focus.
Maps barriers to WCAG criteria, severity, user impact, and remediation steps.
Supports CI accessibility testing and evidence reporting workflows.
limitations: Requires access to the UI, code, design artifacts, or test environment.
Does not replace legal advice or a certified accessibility review.
Automated scans cannot detect every WCAG issue.
Screen reader findings still need environment-specific verification.

use_cases.title: Audit Product Flows
use_cases.description: Review key pages and journeys for WCAG issues before release.

use_cases.title: Fix Accessibility Defects
use_cases.description: Convert audit findings into prioritized remediation steps and retest plans.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Document testing coverage, issues, severity, and follow-up actions for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Start an Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page for WCAG 2.2 AA issues. Check keyboard access, headings, labels, contrast, and screen reader basics.

prompt_templates.title: Review a User Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the checkout journey for accessibility barriers. Prioritize issues by user impact, WCAG criterion, and release risk.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these accessibility findings into a remediation plan. Include owner guidance, testing steps, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ongoing accessibility testing program for this product. Include automated scans, manual checks, CI gates, and reporting cadence.

output_examples.input: Audit a login page for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.
output_examples.output: A prioritized report covering missing labels, focus order, contrast failures, error announcement gaps, WCAG criteria, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Create a remediation plan for keyboard navigation defects.
output_examples.output: A task list with severity, affected components, expected behavior, implementation notes, and retest steps.

output_examples.input: Set up recurring accessibility checks for a web app.
output_examples.output: A testing workflow that combines automated scans, manual screen reader checks, CI reporting, and stakeholder review.

best_practices: Define WCAG level, target journeys, browsers, assistive technology, and success criteria before testing.
Combine automated scans with keyboard, screen reader, contrast, and reflow checks.
Retest each fix and keep evidence for release and compliance decisions.
anti_patterns: Relying only on automated scanners for WCAG compliance decisions.
Reporting issues without user impact, severity, or a clear remediation path.
Changing ARIA before confirming that native HTML cannot solve the problem.

faq.question: What standards does this skill support?
faq.answer: It focuses on WCAG audits, especially Level A and AA checks for web and product experiences.

faq.question: Can it replace manual accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan and perform manual checks, but human review remains necessary.

faq.question: Does it require code access?
faq.answer: Code access helps with remediation, but audits can start from a running UI or design artifacts.

faq.question: Can it create developer tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can translate findings into prioritized fixes, acceptance criteria, and retest steps.

faq.question: Does it support CI accessibility testing?
faq.answer: Yes. The playbook includes examples for axe, pa11y, and workflow-based testing.

faq.question: Is this legal compliance advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides technical accessibility guidance and evidence, not legal advice.
